meta.name: esm
meta.description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 进行蛋白质序列建模与结构预测
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正从事蛋白质相关的生物信息研究
copy.tagline_en: Predict protein structures and analyze sequences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're doing protein-related bioinformatics research

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 esm Python SDK 处理蛋白质：ESM3 生成或补全序列、预测结构、反向折叠，ESMC 提取嵌入向量，ESMFold2 预测全原子结构，也可走 Forge/Biohub 云端推理。
howto.when: 当你直接使用 esm Python SDK，或涉及 ESM3/ESMC 模型 ID、Forge/Biohub 推理客户端等 ESM 相关工作时触发。

say.text: 用 esm3-open 把这条带下划线的序列补全
say.note: 下划线为掩码位，会逐位生成

say.text: 用 ESMC 给我这几条序列算嵌入向量
say.note: 返回可供下游任务使用的 embedding

say.text: 从 target_structure.pdb 反向折叠出序列
say.note: 用序列轨道设计能折叠成该结构的序列

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can work with proteins through the esm Python SDK: generate or complete sequences, predict structures and inverse fold with ESM3, extract embeddings with ESMC, run ESMFold2 folding, and call Forge/Biohub hosted inference.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work directly with the esm Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

say_en.text: Use esm3-open to complete this sequence with underscores
say_en.note: Underscores are masked positions and get generated

say_en.text: Compute ESM C embeddings for these sequences
Inverse fold a sequence from target_structure.pdb
say_en.note: Designs a sequence with the sequence track
